## 0. Libraries and Setup

```{r}
# Libraries
library("tidyr")     # data cleaning utilities
library("dplyr")     # data manipulation

library("BAS")       # Bayesian variable selection
library("rjags")     # Gibbs sampler


library("corrplot")  # plotting correlation matrices
library("ggplot2")   # plotting utilities
library("patchwork") # plotting utilities to handle grids and ggplot
library("bayesplot") # plotting utilities for JAGS results

# Setup
set.seed(42) # for reproducibility
rm(list=ls()) # clear environment
```

## 1. Data Analysis and Pre-processing

-   Name: Airline Customer satisfaction
-   Source : [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/raminhuseyn/airline-customer-satisfaction)

```{r}
# Loading the full dataset
data = read.csv("data/Airline_customer_satisfaction.csv")
data = data.frame(data)
cat(paste("Total number of rows :", dim(data)[1]))
```

```{r}
# Removing NA rows
data <- drop_na(data)
cat(paste("Total number of rows without NA :", dim(data)[1]))
```

```{r}
# Pre-processing the full dataset reducing it to 2000 rows
index = sample(1:nrow(data),2000,replace=F)
data = data[index,]
row.names(data) = 1:nrow(data)
data = data.frame(data)
cat(paste("Size of the reduced dataset: ",dim(data)[1],"x", dim(data)[2]))
```

```{r}
# Renaming columns with snake_case
data <- data %>%
  rename(
    satisfaction = satisfaction,
    customer_type = Customer.Type,
    age = Age,
    type_of_travel = Type.of.Travel,
    class = Class,
    flight_distance = Flight.Distance,
    seat_comfort = Seat.comfort,
    departure_arrival_convenient = Departure.Arrival.time.convenient,
    food_and_drink = Food.and.drink,
    gate_location = Gate.location,
    inflight_wifi_service = Inflight.wifi.service,
    inflight_entertainment = Inflight.entertainment,
    online_support = Online.support,
    ease_of_online_booking = Ease.of.Online.booking,
    on_board_service = On.board.service,
    leg_room_service = Leg.room.service,
    baggage_handling = Baggage.handling,
    checkin_service = Checkin.service,
    cleanliness = Cleanliness,
    online_boarding = Online.boarding,
    departure_delay = Departure.Delay.in.Minutes,
    arrival_delay = Arrival.Delay.in.Minutes
  )
```

```{r}
# Handling Categorical Variables and creating dummy variables
to_numerical <- function(categorical, name){
  factor <- as.factor(categorical)
  cat(paste("Levels for", name, ":\n", paste("'", levels(factor),"' -> ", "[", 0:1, "]", sep="", collapse=", "), "\n\n"))
  return (as.numeric(factor) - 1) 
}

data$satisfaction <- to_numerical(data$satisfaction, "satisfaction")
data$customer_type <- to_numerical(data$customer_type, "customer_type")
data$type_of_travel <- to_numerical(data$type_of_travel, "type_of_travel")

## dummy variables dropping "Business" due to linear dependence
data$class_eco <- ifelse(data$class == "Eco", 1, 0)
data$class_eco_plus <- ifelse(data$class == "Eco Plus", 1, 0)
data$class <- NULL
cat("The column 'class' has been dummyfied to :\n class_eco, class_eco_plus")
```

```{r}
# Split data 
train_test_split <- function(dataset, split_percentage){
  test_size = split_percentage * nrow(dataset)
  test_idxs = sample(1:nrow(dataset), test_size)
  test_set = dataset[test_idxs, ]
  train_set = dataset[-test_idxs, ]
  return (list(test = test_set, train = train_set))
}
```

```{r}
FULL_DATASET_SIZE = dim(data)[1]
SPLIT = 0.3
splitted_dataset <- train_test_split(data, SPLIT)
cat("Train length :", dim(splitted_dataset$train)[1])
cat("\nTest length :", dim(splitted_dataset$test)[1])
```

```{r}
# Storing the train and test set
write.csv(splitted_dataset$test,"data/reduced_test.csv", row.names = F)
write.csv(splitted_dataset$train,"data/reduced_train.csv", row.names = F)
```

## 3. Bernoulli Regression using JAGS (Suggested Variables)

$$
\begin{align*}
  & y_i \mid p_i \overset{ind}\sim \mathscr{B}e(p_i), &\qquad i=1,\ldots,n \\
  & \log\left(\frac{p_i}{1-p_i}\right) = \beta_0 + x_i \beta, &\qquad \rightarrow\text{logistic link} \\
  &\beta_j \overset{iid}\sim \mathscr{N}(0,100), &\qquad j=1,\ldots,p
\end{align*}
$$

```{r}
# Preparing the parameters
Y = as.numeric(
      splitted_dataset$train$satisfaction
    )

X = as.matrix(
      splitted_dataset$train %>% 
        select(age, seat_comfort, class_eco, class_eco_plus, arrival_delay)
    )
X = scale(X)

Xp = as.matrix(
      splitted_dataset$test %>% 
        select(age, seat_comfort, class_eco, class_eco_plus, arrival_delay)
     )
Xp = scale(Xp)

n = dim(X)[1] # number of samples in the training data set
npred = dim(Xp)[1] # number of samples in the test data set
par = dim(X)[2] # dimension on the linear model

data_list <- list(X=X, Y=Y, Xp=Xp, n=n, npred=npred, par=par)
```

```{r}
model_string = textConnection(
"model {
  # Likelihood
  for (i in 1:n) {
    Y[i] ~ dbern(p[i])
    logit(p[i]) = beta0 + X[i,] %*% beta
  }
  
  # Predictive 
  for (i in 1:npred){
    ypred[i] ~ dbern(ppred[i])
    logit(ppred[i]) <- beta0 + Xp[i,] %*% beta
  }
  
  # Prior
  beta0 ~ dnorm(0, 0.001)
  for (j in 1:par) {
    beta[j] ~ dnorm(0, 0.001)
  }
}")
```

```{r}
# Building the Jags Model
burn.in = 200
n.iter = 2000
n.adapt = 200
thin = 2
n.chains = 2

model <- jags.model(model_string,
                    data=data_list,
                    n.chains=n.chains,
                    n.adapt=n.adapt)

update(model, n.iter=burn.in)
samples <- coda.samples(model,
                        variable.names=c("beta","beta0", "ypred"),
                        n.iter=n.iter,
                        thin=thin)
```

```{r}
mcmc_trace(samples,regex_pars="beta")
```

```{r}
mcmc_areas_ridges(samples,regex_pars="beta", prob = 0.98)  
```
```{r}
summary_stats <- summary(samples)

# Means
posterior_means <- summary_stats$statistics[,"Mean"]

# Variances
posterior_vars <- summary_stats$statistics[,"SD"]^2

# Filter only beta parameters
beta_means <- posterior_means[grep("^beta\\[", names(posterior_means))]
beta_vars <- posterior_vars[grep("^beta\\[", names(posterior_vars))]

# Dataframe for visualization
beta_df <- data.frame(
  Parameter = names(beta_means),
  Variable = colnames(X),
  Mean = beta_means,
  Variance = beta_vars
)

# Sort by mean
beta_df <- beta_df[order(beta_df$Mean), ]

rownames(beta_df) <- NULL #reset row names
beta_df
```

```{r}
mcmc_trace(samples, pars = c("ypred[1]","ypred[2]","ypred[3]","ypred[4]","ypred[5]","ypred[6]"))
```

```{r}
# Compute a df contatining sampling counts
preds_df <- data.frame(samples[[1]]) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "prediction") %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  filter(grepl("ypred", variable)) %>%
  summarise(
    zeros = sum(prediction==0),
    ones = sum(prediction==1),
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c("zeros", "ones"), names_to = "value", values_to = "count")

# obtains the ones and zeros counts for a certain variable
get_preds <- function(idx) {
  res <- preds_df %>% filter(variable==paste("ypred.",idx,".", sep=""))
  return (res)
}

# plots variables counts in a grid
plots <- lapply(1:6, function(i) {
  ggplot(get_preds(i)) +
    geom_col(aes(x = variable, y = count, fill = value), position = "dodge") +
    ggtitle(paste("ypred", i))
})

wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3)
```

```{r, fig.width=8}

acf(samples[[1]][,6], main="Beta[0]")
for (i in 1:5){
  acf(samples[[1]][,i], main=paste("Beta[", i,"]", sep=""))
}
for (i in 7:10){
  acf(samples[[1]][,i], main=paste("Ypred[", i-6,"]", sep=""))
}
```

```{r}
Ytrue = splitted_dataset$test %>% select(satisfaction)
Ytrue = Ytrue[,1]
Yrep = samples[[1]][,7:(length(Ytrue)+6)]
ppc_bars(Ytrue, Yrep) 
```

```{r}
ppc_error_hist(Ytrue, Yrep[100:105,],bins=3)+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(),
        axis.text.x = element_text()) +
  ggtitle("Residual Errors on Predictions")
```

```{r}
compute_accuracy <- function(Ytrue, Ypred) {
  return(round(sum(Ytrue == Ypred) / length(Ytrue), digits=4))
}
avg_accuracy <- function(Ytrue, Ypreds) {
  accs <- apply(Ypreds, 1, function(row) compute_accuracy(Ytrue, row))
  return(round(mean(accs), 4))
}
```

```{r}
cat(paste("Average Accuracy: ", avg_accuracy(Ytrue, Yrep), "%", sep=""))
```

## 5. Spike and Slab in a Logit Bernoulli Regression


$$
\begin{align*}
  & y_i \mid p_i \overset{ind}\sim \mathscr{B}e(p_i), &\qquad i=1,\ldots,n \\
  & \log\left(\frac{p_i}{1-p_i}\right) = \beta_0 + x_i \beta, &\qquad \rightarrow\text{logistic link} \\
  & \beta_j \mid \gamma_j \overset{ind}\sim (1-\gamma_j)\,\delta_{(0)} + \gamma_j\,\mathscr{N}\left(0,    100\right), \\
  & \gamma_j \mid \theta_j \overset{ind}\sim \mathscr{B}e\left(\theta_j\right), \\[5pt]
  & \theta_{j} \overset{iid}\sim \mathcal U_{0,1}\left(\theta_j\right), &\rightarrow[0,1]\text{ uniform}
\end{align*}
$$


```{r}
# Preparing the parameters
Y = as.numeric( splitted_dataset$train$satisfaction )

X = as.matrix( splitted_dataset$train %>% select(-satisfaction) ) # full train set 
X = scale(X)

Xp = as.matrix( splitted_dataset$test %>% select(-satisfaction) ) # full test set
Xp = scale(Xp)

n =     dim(X)[1]  # number of samples in the training data set
npred = dim(Xp)[1] # number of samples in the test data set
par =   dim(X)[2]  # dimension on the linear model

data_list <- list(X=X, Y=Y, Xp=Xp, n=n, npred=npred, par=par)
```

```{r}
model_string = textConnection(
"model {
  # Likelihood
  for (i in 1:n) {
    Y[i] ~ dbern(p[i])
    logit(p[i]) = beta0 + X[i,] %*% beta
  }
  
  # Predictive 
  for (i in 1:npred){
    ypred[i] ~ dbern(ppred[i])
    logit(ppred[i]) <- beta0 + Xp[i,] %*% beta
  }
  
  # Model encoding
  for (j in 1:par) {
  	inclusionindex[j] = gamma[j]*pow(2,j)
  }
  model_encoding = 1 + sum(inclusionindex[])
  
  # Prior
  beta0 ~ dnorm(0, 0.001)
  for (j in 1:par) {
    gamma[j] ~ dbern(theta[j])
    theta[j] ~ dunif(0,1)
    beta_temp[j] ~ dnorm(0, 0.001)
    beta[j] = gamma[j] * beta_temp[j]
  }
}")
```

```{r}
# initializing the model making betas and gamma start from 0 and theta being 0.5
inits = list(beta0=0, beta_temp=rep(0,par), gamma=rep(0,par), theta=rep(0.5,par))

burn.in = 500
n.iter = 4000
n.adapt = 200
thin = 3
n.chains = 1

model <- jags.model(model_string,
                    data=data_list,
                    n.chains=n.chains,
                    n.adapt=n.adapt,
                    inits=inits)

update(model, n.iter=burn.in)
samples <- coda.samples(model,
                        variable.names=c("beta","beta0", "ypred", "model_encoding", "gamma"),
                        n.iter=n.iter,
                        thin=thin)
```

```{r}
# Distribution over model encodings
visited_models = sort(table(samples[,"model_encoding"]),decreasing=TRUE)
barplot(visited_models/sum(table(samples[,"model_encoding"])),xlab="Model encoding",ylab="Posterior probability")
```

```{r}
# Posterior probabilities over gamma (inclusion of variables in the model)
gamma_samples = samples[[1]][,24:45]
post_mean_g = apply(gamma_samples, 2, "mean")

# Print the probabilities of inclusion:
data.frame(post_mean_g)
```

```{r}
# Get the unique profiles and sort the results:
unique_model = unique(as.matrix(gamma_samples),MARGIN=1)
freq = apply(unique_model,1,function(b) sum(apply(gamma_samples,MARGIN=1, function(a) all(a == b))))
most_freq = as.logical(unique_model[which.max(freq),])
most_freq_idxs = which(most_freq == TRUE)

# Select the HPD model and print the variable names:
cat(paste(1:10,":", colnames(X)[most_freq]), sep=",\n")
```

```{r}
for(k in most_freq_idxs){ 
  plot(samples[[1]][,k], main=paste("beta[",k,"] : ",colnames(X)[k], sep="")) }
```

```{r}
plot_title <- ggtitle("Prediction v.s. True counts")

Ytrue = splitted_dataset$test %>% select(satisfaction)
Ytrue = Ytrue[,1]
Yrep = samples[[1]][,47:(length(Ytrue)+46)]
ppc_bars(Ytrue, Yrep) + plot_title
```

```{r}
ppc_error_hist(Ytrue, Yrep[100:105,], bins=3)+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(),
        axis.text.x = element_text()) +
  ggtitle("Residual Errors on Predictions")
```

```{r}
cat(paste("Average Accuracy: ", avg_accuracy(Ytrue, Yrep), "%", sep=""))
```
